race.comment: MID CITY BOSS (1) was out of the placings last time when fifth at Casino (17.81) but scored four back at Casino (17.01). Safe beginner who draws ideally on the inside. Should bounce back. TRUE BLUE BILLY (7) has been in super consistent form recently with two minors on end before missing the frame latest finishing fifth (17.87) at this track. Has won two of three starts from this draw. Should be in this for a long way. BIG CUTIE (2) showed little early speed at her last couple, the latest finishing sixth (18.09) in a Grade 5 at this track. Has performed well from this box with a win and two minor placings to her name from four starts. Cannot be underestimated. MY JULIA (3) was unplaced here last start but gets her chance to atone.
